item.title: Ask HN: What can I do with a single R9700?
item.summary: Hi HN, I’m considering getting an R9700, budget only for one unit currently. Is there anything useful I can do with local LLMs within its 32G VRAM? I’m also thinking to try and learn building a simple inference engine. Any thoughts? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49222031 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
